ratings.note: f: any skipper whose boat exceeds the chosen berth limit, made likelier by the unlabelled limits; i: dead end on the critical journey, recovery only by restart or office phone call; p: recurs since the cause is never stated. s=4.

f: every over-length entry (feet, LOA vs hull confusion); i: aria shows main holds only heading and reference code, no field named, no fix, no link back, so the booking is blocked or needs a call; p: recurs each attempt. s=4.

f: every BST booking planned from the table, though many skippers expect and convert UT tables; i: one-hour error against a ~4 h gate window can mean arriving with the gate shut; p: learnable once noticed. s=3.

f: everyone using the table during BST; i: caption says UTC while arrival options carry no zone, so a mis-conversion mis-times arrival and is caught nowhere downstream; p: overcome once the offset is noticed. s=3.
f: only mistyped MMSIs; i: a wrong identifier silently reaches the office, an uncaught data error; p: once per mistake. s=2.
f: date changes are a core task, often weather-driven; i: hidden behind an unlabelled icon, but the fallback is re-entering three fields on the first page; p: learned by returning skippers. s=2.
Same hidden 'Change dates' route, plus a detached button drawing the eye; f: core task; i: detour or short re-entry; p: learnable. s=2.
f: only in error states; i: error text and summary still mark the field, border is a weaker secondary cue; p: per error occurrence. s=1.
f: every phone view; i: ragged lines, content still readable; p: recurring. Impact 0 caps at 1.

f: every booking; i: record lacks the chosen time, a recall burden; p: whenever consulted. s=3, rated 2 because actual entry is governed by the gate window, not the booked hour, and the time was self-chosen.
f: only skippers who spot an error at review; i: no change links, but browser/gesture Back over URL-parameter pages is the likely recovery; p: each such booking. s=2.
f: BST bookings planned from the table; i: hour error relative to the gate window; p: learnable. s=3. Same problem as the other UTC findings.
f: boats longer than the cheaper berths whose skippers misjudge fit; i: fit is checked only after the whole boat form, leading to the dead end (rated separately); p: recurs per mismatch. s=3.
f: core task, weather-driven changes common; i: discoverability only, menu works and fallback re-entry is short; p: learnable. s=2.
f: only mistyped years; i: a booking for a past date confirms and the skipper may arrive with no berth held, a support contact; p: once per mistake. s=3.
f: error states only; i: error message remains above the field, border is a secondary cue; p: per error. s=1.
Same dead-end stop page: f: any over-length entry; i: blocks the critical journey with no reason or path, phone only; p: recurs. s=4.
f: every booking, but matters mainly near the limit; i: memory bridge that feeds the over-length stop; p: every visit to the step. s=2.
f: checking tides or rules mid-flow is invited by the header; i: all entries lost without warning, full re-entry on a phone; p: recurs, though users may learn to avoid the links. s=3.
f: everyone viewing the table; i: header/figure misalignment, but two columns are hard to confuse; p: recurring. Impact 0 caps at 1.
f: newcomers who pick a time without cross-checking the tide; i: arrival when the gate is shut, discovered only at the entrance; p: per booking. s=3.
f: every booking; i: native radio dot still shows the choice; p: recurring. Impact 0 caps at 1.

f: every booking, though four steps are short; i: orientation uncertainty only, task completes; p: every page. s=2.
f: boats over 12 m; i: label mismatch, but the wall berth is visibly listed inside the group; p: one-time. s=1.
f: boats without an MMSI and skippers unsure of the term; i: required with no hint or alternative, blocks booking or forces a call; p: every booking for such boats. s=4.
f: only out-of-range or past dates; i: confirmation for a date the harbour does not take, a support contact; p: once per mistake. s=3.

f: every booking; i: uncertainty whether Continue commits, no blockage; p: every page. s=2.

f: any arrival outside the one listed week; i: core task 3 unsupported for that date; p: every such booking. s=4, rated 3 because these users routinely carry other tide sources (almanac, apps), so the cost is a detour, not a block.
f: any arrival outside 17-23 Oct; i: table silently shows the wrong week, task 3 fails without explanation; p: every visit. s=4, rated 3 because skippers have other tide sources.
